```{r}
# 0. Settings
# ---------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
COMMON_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Cox_common_data.rds")

# Diagnostic rule for the auxiliary Sex x Marriage analysis.
# This is a prespecified stability screen for the interaction model, not a
# substantive population threshold.
MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL <- 5L

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("survival", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(survival)
library(openxlsx)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(COMMON_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Cox_common_data.rds was not found at: ", COMMON_RDS, "\n",
    "Run A_Ever_Dibao_Cox_revised.R first. The Never model must use the ",
    "same common sample and income cutoffs as the Ever model."
  )
}
```


```{r}
# 1. Helper functions
# ---------------------------
fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(
      formula,
      data = data,
      ties = "efron",
      cluster = individual_id,
      robust = TRUE,
      x = TRUE,
      model = TRUE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  list(
    fit = fit,
    warnings = unique(warnings_seen)
  )
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_table <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)

  out <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    beta = coef_table[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_table[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95 = ci_table[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95 = ci_table[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if ("robust se" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "robust se"]
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "se(coef)"]
  } else {
    out$robust_se <- NA_real_
  }

  out[, c(
    "term", "beta", "robust_se", "HR",
    "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value"
  )]
}

make_readable_main_results <- function(x) {
  label_map <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated/Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "1 living child vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "2 living children vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "3+ living children vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Coresident child Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Coresident child Unknown vs No"
  )

  out <- x

  out$comparison <- ifelse(
    out$term %in% names(label_map),
    unname(label_map[out$term]),
    out$term
  )

  out$HR_95CI <- sprintf(
    "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
    out$HR, out$lower_95, out$upper_95
  )

  out$p_display <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$p_value),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(out$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", out$p_value))
  )

  out[, c(
    "comparison", "HR_95CI", "p_display",
    "beta", "robust_se", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value"
  )]
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(
      fit,
      transform = "km",
      terms = TRUE,
      global = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      structure(
        list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
        class = "cox_zph_error"
      )
    }
  )
}

ph_table <- function(ph_object) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) {
    return(data.frame(
      term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p = NA_real_,
      message = ph_object$message,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  x$term <- rownames(x)
  rownames(x) <- NULL

  x[, c("term", setdiff(names(x), "term")), drop = FALSE]
}

# First try cox.zph() on the formal clustered robust Cox fit.
# If that covariance is computationally singular, fit the EXACT SAME Cox
# formula without cluster/robust ONLY as a PH diagnostic fallback.
# The fallback does NOT replace the main HR model.
run_ph_diagnostic <- function(formula, data, clustered_fit) {
  primary <- safe_cox_zph(clustered_fit)

  if (!inherits(primary, "cox_zph_error")) {
    tab <- ph_table(primary)
    tab$diagnostic_source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
    tab$primary_error <- NA_character_

    return(list(
      object = primary,
      table = tab,
      source = "clustered robust Cox fit",
      primary_error = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  diagnostic_fit <- coxph(
    formula,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )

  fallback <- safe_cox_zph(diagnostic_fit)
  tab <- ph_table(fallback)
  tab$diagnostic_source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
  tab$primary_error <- primary$message

  list(
    object = fallback,
    table = tab,
    source = "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback",
    primary_error = primary$message
  )
}

wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  ok <- is.finite(b)
  if (!all(ok)) {
    b <- b[ok]
    V <- V[ok, ok, drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (length(b) == 0 || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol

  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)
  p <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    chisq = W,
    df = df,
    p_value = p
  )
}

linear_combination_hr <- function(fit, weights, label) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)

  missing_terms <- setdiff(names(weights), names(b))

  if (
    length(missing_terms) > 0 ||
      any(!is.finite(b[names(weights)])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[names(weights), names(weights), drop = FALSE]))
  ) {
    return(data.frame(
      label = label,
      log_HR = NA_real_,
      SE = NA_real_,
      HR = NA_real_,
      lower_95 = NA_real_,
      upper_95 = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  w <- rep(0, length(b))
  names(w) <- names(b)
  w[names(weights)] <- weights

  est <- sum(w * b)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V %*% w))
  z <- est / se

  data.frame(
    label = label,
    log_HR = est,
    SE = se,
    HR = exp(est),
    lower_95 = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper_95 = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

make_cell_qa <- function(data, variable) {
  levs <- levels(data[[variable]])

  if (is.null(levs)) {
    levs <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[variable]])))
  }

  out <- lapply(levs, function(z) {
    d <- data[
      as.character(data[[variable]]) == z,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      variable = variable,
      level = z,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

make_sex_marriage_cell_qa <- function(data) {
  sexes <- levels(data$sex)
  marriages <- levels(data$marriage_status)

  grid <- expand.grid(
    sex = sexes,
    marriage_status = marriages,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    sx <- grid$sex[i]
    ms <- grid$marriage_status[i]

    d <- data[
      as.character(data$sex) == sx &
        as.character(data$marriage_status) == ms,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      sex = sx,
      marriage_status = ms,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

print_table_section <- function(title, x, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(title, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")

  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No result available.\n")
  } else {
    print(x, row.names = FALSE, digits = digits)
  }
}

add_sheet <- function(wb, name, x) {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, x)
}

# Checks that one person's start-stop intervals do not overlap.
check_nonoverlap <- function(data) {
  ids <- unique(data$individual_id)
  bad <- character(0)

  for (id in ids) {
    d <- data[data$individual_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
    d <- d[order(d$start, d$stop), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(d) > 1) {
      overlap <- d$start[-1] < d$stop[-nrow(d)]
      if (any(overlap, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        bad <- c(bad, id)
      }
    }
  }

  unique(bad)
}

# ---------------------------
# 2. Read and validate the common Method A object
# ---------------------------
common <- readRDS(COMMON_RDS)

required_common_objects <- c(
  "analysis_intervals",
  "income_cutoffs",
  "sample_flow",
  "group_summary"
)

missing_common_objects <- setdiff(
  required_common_objects,
  names(common)
)

if (length(missing_common_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The common RDS is missing required object(s): ",
    paste(missing_common_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

analysis_intervals <- common$analysis_intervals

required_columns <- c(
  "individual_id",
  "household_id",
  "dibao_group",
  "start",
  "stop",
  "event",
  "person_years",
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "long_mean_household_income_pc",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "age_group"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(analysis_intervals)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "analysis_intervals is missing required column(s): ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(common$income_cutoffs) != 2 ||
    any(!is.finite(common$income_cutoffs))) {
  stop("The common RDS does not contain two valid finite income cutoffs.")
}

q1 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[1])
q2 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[2])

if (!(q1 < q2)) {
  stop("Income cutoffs are invalid: q1 must be smaller than q2.")
}

# ---------------------------
# 3. Select Never Dibao records
# ---------------------------
never_data_all <- analysis_intervals[
  as.character(analysis_intervals$dibao_group) == "Never",
  , drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(never_data_all) == 0) {
  stop("No Never Dibao person-period records were found in the common RDS.")
}

# Basic integrity checks before modeling.
if (any(is.na(never_data_all$start)) ||
    any(is.na(never_data_all$stop))) {
  stop("Never data contain missing start or stop times.")
}

if (any(never_data_all$stop <= never_data_all$start)) {
  stop("Never data contain stop <= start intervals.")
}

if (any(!never_data_all$event %in% c(0, 1))) {
  stop("Never data contain event values other than 0/1.")
}

events_per_person <- tapply(
  never_data_all$event,
  never_data_all$individual_id,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (any(events_per_person > 1)) {
  stop("At least one Never participant has more than one death event.")
}

bad_overlap <- check_nonoverlap(never_data_all)
if (length(bad_overlap) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Overlapping person-period intervals detected for ",
    length(bad_overlap),
    " Never participant(s). First IDs: ",
    paste(head(bad_overlap, 10), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 4. Marriage Unknown handling for the formal Never Cox model
# ---------------------------
# In the current common sample, marriage Unknown is a very sparse category
# and has no death events in Never. It is retained in the common object and QA,
# but excluded from the Cox model intervals rather than estimating an unstable
# zero-event coefficient.
marriage_unknown_excluded <- never_data_all[
  as.character(never_data_all$marriage_status) == "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

never_data <- never_data_all[
  as.character(never_data_all$marriage_status) != "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

never_data <- droplevels(never_data)

# Re-assert reference categories and factor order.
never_data$sex <- factor(
  never_data$sex,
  levels = c("Male", "Female")
)

never_data$income_tertile <- factor(
  never_data$income_tertile,
  levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")
)

never_data$marriage_status <- factor(
  never_data$marriage_status,
  levels = c(
    "Partnered",
    "Widowed",
    "Separated-Divorced",
    "Never married"
  )
)

never_data$living_children <- factor(
  never_data$living_children,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
)

never_data$coresident_child <- factor(
  never_data$coresident_child,
  levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
)

never_data$age_group <- factor(
  never_data$age_group,
  levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
)

if (any(is.na(never_data$sex))) {
  stop("Missing sex found in final Never Cox model data.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$income_tertile))) {
  stop("Missing income tertile found in final Never Cox model data.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$marriage_status))) {
  stop("Unexpected marriage-status code found after Never recoding/filtering.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$age_group))) {
  stop("Missing age group found in final Never Cox model data.")
}

if (sum(never_data$event, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  stop("No death events remain in the Never Cox model data.")
}

marriage_unknown_exclusion_summary <- data.frame(
  rule = "Marriage status Unknown excluded from Cox model intervals",
  records_excluded = nrow(marriage_unknown_excluded),
  persons_affected = length(unique(marriage_unknown_excluded$individual_id)),
  events_excluded = sum(marriage_unknown_excluded$event, na.rm = TRUE),
  person_years_excluded = sum(
    marriage_unknown_excluded$stop - marriage_unknown_excluded$start,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Sample summaries and common income cutoffs
# ---------------------------
sample_summary <- data.frame(
  stage = c(
    "Never in common Method A data",
    "Never main Cox after excluding marriage Unknown"
  ),
  persons = c(
    length(unique(never_data_all$individual_id)),
    length(unique(never_data$individual_id))
  ),
  households = c(
    length(unique(never_data_all$household_id)),
    length(unique(never_data$household_id))
  ),
  person_intervals = c(
    nrow(never_data_all),
    nrow(never_data)
  ),
  person_years = c(
    sum(never_data_all$stop - never_data_all$start, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(never_data$stop - never_data$start, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  death_events = c(
    sum(never_data_all$event, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(never_data$event, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

income_cutoff_table <- data.frame(
  cutoff = c("33.333%", "66.667%"),
  value = c(q1, q2),
  method = "Same Method A common cutoffs generated by revised Ever script",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# 6. Never Dibao main Cox model
# ---------------------------
main_formula <- Surv(start, stop, event) ~
  sex +
  income_tertile +
  marriage_status +
  living_children +
  coresident_child +
  strata(age_group)

main_fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(
  main_formula,
  never_data
)

main_fit <- main_fit_obj$fit
main_results <- extract_cox_results(main_fit)
main_results_readable <- make_readable_main_results(main_results)
```


```{r}
# 7. PH diagnostic
# ---------------------------
main_ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
  main_formula,
  never_data,
  main_fit
)

main_ph <- main_ph_diag$object
main_ph_table <- main_ph_diag$table

ph_diagnostic_info <- data.frame(
  model = "Never main Cox",
  diagnostic_source = main_ph_diag$source,
  primary_error = ifelse(
    is.na(main_ph_diag$primary_error),
    "",
    main_ph_diag$primary_error
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# 8. Auxiliary Sex x Marital status analysis
# ---------------------------
# The main Cox model keeps all observed substantive marital categories.
# The auxiliary interaction model is stricter because sex-specific sparse cells
# can create infinite interaction coefficients.
sex_marriage_cell_qa <- make_sex_marriage_cell_qa(never_data)

marital_nonref <- setdiff(
  levels(never_data$marriage_status),
  "Partnered"
)

supported_marital_levels <- character(0)

for (lev in marital_nonref) {
  z <- sex_marriage_cell_qa[
    sex_marriage_cell_qa$marriage_status == lev &
      sex_marriage_cell_qa$sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    nrow(z) == 2 &&
      all(z$events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL)
  ) {
    supported_marital_levels <- c(
      supported_marital_levels,
      lev
    )
  }
}

sex_marriage_level_eligibility <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(marital_nonref, function(lev) {
    z <- sex_marriage_cell_qa[
      sex_marriage_cell_qa$marriage_status == lev &
        sex_marriage_cell_qa$sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      marriage_status = lev,
      male_events = if (any(z$sex == "Male")) {
        z$events[z$sex == "Male"][1]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      female_events = if (any(z$sex == "Female")) {
        z$events[z$sex == "Female"][1]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      eligible_for_sex_interaction =
        lev %in% supported_marital_levels,
      rule = paste0(
        ">=",
        MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL,
        " deaths in each sex-specific cell"
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

sex_marriage_fit <- NULL
sex_marriage_coefficients <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_block <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_level_HRs <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_ph <- NULL
sex_marriage_ph_table <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_warnings <- character(0)

if (length(supported_marital_levels) > 0) {
  sex_marriage_data <- never_data[
    as.character(never_data$marriage_status) %in%
      c("Partnered", supported_marital_levels),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  sex_marriage_data <- droplevels(sex_marriage_data)

  sex_marriage_data$sex <- factor(
    sex_marriage_data$sex,
    levels = c("Male", "Female")
  )

  sex_marriage_data$marriage_status <- factor(
    sex_marriage_data$marriage_status,
    levels = c("Partnered", supported_marital_levels)
  )

  sex_marriage_formula <- Surv(start, stop, event) ~
    sex * marriage_status +
    income_tertile +
    living_children +
    coresident_child +
    strata(age_group)

  sex_marriage_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(
    sex_marriage_formula,
    sex_marriage_data
  )

  sex_marriage_fit <- sex_marriage_obj$fit
  sex_marriage_warnings <- sex_marriage_obj$warnings
  sex_marriage_coefficients <- extract_cox_results(
    sex_marriage_fit
  )

  interaction_terms <- grep(
    ":",
    names(coef(sex_marriage_fit)),
    value = TRUE
  )

  sex_marriage_block <- wald_block(
    sex_marriage_fit,
    interaction_terms
  )

  sex_marriage_block$test <-
    "Sex x Marital status overall interaction (eligible levels only)"

  sex_marriage_block <- sex_marriage_block[
    , c("test", "chisq", "df", "p_value")
  ]

  # Sex-specific marital-status HRs relative to Partnered.
  for (lev in supported_marital_levels) {
    main_term <- paste0(
      "marriage_status",
      lev
    )

    male_row <- linear_combination_hr(
      sex_marriage_fit,
      setNames(1, main_term),
      paste0(
        "Male: ",
        lev,
        " vs Partnered"
      )
    )

    possible_interactions <- c(
      paste0(
        "sexFemale:marriage_status",
        lev
      ),
      paste0(
        "marriage_status",
        lev,
        ":sexFemale"
      )
    )

    int_term <- possible_interactions[
      possible_interactions %in%
        names(coef(sex_marriage_fit))
    ]

    if (length(int_term) == 1) {
      female_row <- linear_combination_hr(
        sex_marriage_fit,
        setNames(
          c(1, 1),
          c(main_term, int_term)
        ),
        paste0(
          "Female: ",
          lev,
          " vs Partnered"
        )
      )
    } else {
      female_row <- data.frame(
        label = paste0(
          "Female: ",
          lev,
          " vs Partnered"
        ),
        log_HR = NA_real_,
        SE = NA_real_,
        HR = NA_real_,
        lower_95 = NA_real_,
        upper_95 = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    }

    sex_marriage_level_HRs <- rbind(
      sex_marriage_level_HRs,
      male_row,
      female_row
    )
  }

  sex_marriage_ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
    sex_marriage_formula,
    sex_marriage_data,
    sex_marriage_fit
  )

  sex_marriage_ph <- sex_marriage_ph_diag$object
  sex_marriage_ph_table <- sex_marriage_ph_diag$table

} else {
  sex_marriage_block <- data.frame(
    test = "Sex x Marital status overall interaction",
    chisq = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    note = paste0(
      "Not fitted: no non-reference marital level met the >=",
      MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL,
      " deaths-per-sex rule."
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  sex_marriage_ph_table <- data.frame(
    term = "NOT_FITTED",
    chisq = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p = NA_real_,
    message = "Sex x Marital status model not fitted because of sparse cells.",
    diagnostic_source = NA_character_,
    primary_error = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------------------------
# 9. Cell counts / sparse-data QA
# ---------------------------
qa_variables <- c(
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "age_group"
)

cell_qa <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    qa_variables,
    function(v) make_cell_qa(never_data, v)
  )
)

# <5 events is flagged for review, not automatically removed from the main Cox.
sparse_qa <- cell_qa[
  cell_qa$events < 5,
  , drop = FALSE
]
```

```{r}
# Method A - Never Dibao: Cox models with HUKOU adjustment.
# Uses the SAME common RDS already generated by the updated Ever script.
# No re-reading CSV files, no Ever rerun, no new cleaning of the common data.
# HUKOU was fixed in the Ever common data at the FIRST non-missing wave
# (2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020); 2=non-agricultural reference,
# 1=agricultural comparison; later HUKOU changes are ignored.
# Exclude missing HUKOU only at the Cox model-data stage.

# 0. Settings
# ---------------------------
DATA_DIR <- "."
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "A_Cox_outputs")
COMMON_RDS <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Cox_common_data.rds")

# Diagnostic rule for the auxiliary Sex x Marriage analysis.
# This is a prespecified stability screen for the interaction model, not a
# substantive population threshold.
MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL <- 5L

dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "csv"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_packages <- c("survival", "openxlsx")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

library(survival)
library(openxlsx)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(COMMON_RDS)) {
  stop(
    "A_Cox_common_data.rds was not found at: ", COMMON_RDS, "\n",
    "Please use the existing common RDS generated by the UPDATED Ever ",
    "Dibao HUKOU script. Never must use the same income cutoffs."
  )
}
# 1. Helper functions
# ---------------------------
fit_cox_with_warnings <- function(formula, data) {
  warnings_seen <- character(0)

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(
      formula,
      data = data,
      ties = "efron",
      cluster = individual_id,
      robust = TRUE,
      x = TRUE,
      model = TRUE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warnings_seen <<- c(warnings_seen, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  list(
    fit = fit,
    warnings = unique(warnings_seen)
  )
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit) {
  s <- summary(fit)
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients)
  ci_table <- as.data.frame(s$conf.int)

  out <- data.frame(
    term = rownames(coef_table),
    beta = coef_table[, "coef"],
    HR = ci_table[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower_95 = ci_table[, "lower .95"],
    upper_95 = ci_table[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = coef_table[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if ("robust se" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "robust se"]
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(coef_table)) {
    out$robust_se <- coef_table[, "se(coef)"]
  } else {
    out$robust_se <- NA_real_
  }

  out[, c(
    "term", "beta", "robust_se", "HR",
    "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value"
  )]
}

make_readable_main_results <- function(x) {
  label_map <- c(
    "sexFemale" = "Female vs Male",
    "income_tertileT2" = "Income T2 vs T1",
    "income_tertileT3" = "Income T3 vs T1",
    "marriage_statusWidowed" = "Widowed vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusSeparated-Divorced" = "Separated/Divorced vs Partnered",
    "marriage_statusNever married" = "Never married vs Partnered",
    "living_children1" = "1 living child vs 0",
    "living_children2" = "2 living children vs 0",
    "living_children3+" = "3+ living children vs 0",
    "living_childrenUnknown" = "Living children Unknown vs 0",
    "coresident_childYes" = "Coresident child Yes vs No",
    "coresident_childUnknown" = "Coresident child Unknown vs No",
    "hukouAgricultural" = "Agricultural Hukou vs Non-agricultural Hukou"
  )

  out <- x

  out$comparison <- ifelse(
    out$term %in% names(label_map),
    unname(label_map[out$term]),
    out$term
  )

  out$HR_95CI <- sprintf(
    "%.3f (%.3f-%.3f)",
    out$HR, out$lower_95, out$upper_95
  )

  out$p_display <- ifelse(
    is.na(out$p_value),
    NA_character_,
    ifelse(out$p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", out$p_value))
  )

  out[, c(
    "comparison", "HR_95CI", "p_display",
    "beta", "robust_se", "HR", "lower_95", "upper_95", "p_value"
  )]
}

safe_cox_zph <- function(fit) {
  tryCatch(
    cox.zph(
      fit,
      transform = "km",
      terms = TRUE,
      global = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      structure(
        list(message = conditionMessage(e)),
        class = "cox_zph_error"
      )
    }
  )
}

ph_table <- function(ph_object) {
  if (inherits(ph_object, "cox_zph_error")) {
    return(data.frame(
      term = "PH_TEST_ERROR",
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = NA_real_,
      p = NA_real_,
      message = ph_object$message,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(ph_object$table)
  x$term <- rownames(x)
  rownames(x) <- NULL

  x[, c("term", setdiff(names(x), "term")), drop = FALSE]
}

# First try cox.zph() on the formal clustered robust Cox fit.
# If that covariance is computationally singular, fit the EXACT SAME Cox
# formula without cluster/robust ONLY as a PH diagnostic fallback.
# The fallback does NOT replace the main HR model.
run_ph_diagnostic <- function(formula, data, clustered_fit) {
  primary <- safe_cox_zph(clustered_fit)

  if (!inherits(primary, "cox_zph_error")) {
    tab <- ph_table(primary)
    tab$diagnostic_source <- "clustered robust Cox fit"
    tab$primary_error <- NA_character_

    return(list(
      object = primary,
      table = tab,
      source = "clustered robust Cox fit",
      primary_error = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  diagnostic_fit <- coxph(
    formula,
    data = data,
    ties = "efron",
    x = TRUE,
    model = TRUE
  )

  fallback <- safe_cox_zph(diagnostic_fit)
  tab <- ph_table(fallback)
  tab$diagnostic_source <- "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback"
  tab$primary_error <- primary$message

  list(
    object = fallback,
    table = tab,
    source = "same formula, unclustered diagnostic fallback",
    primary_error = primary$message
  )
}

wald_block <- function(fit, coefficient_names) {
  b_all <- coef(fit)
  coefficient_names <- intersect(coefficient_names, names(b_all))

  if (length(coefficient_names) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  b <- b_all[coefficient_names]
  V <- vcov(fit)[coefficient_names, coefficient_names, drop = FALSE]

  ok <- is.finite(b)
  if (!all(ok)) {
    b <- b[ok]
    V <- V[ok, ok, drop = FALSE]
  }

  if (length(b) == 0 || any(!is.finite(V))) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  ee <- eigen(V, symmetric = TRUE)
  tol <- max(abs(ee$values)) * 1e-10
  keep <- ee$values > tol

  if (!any(keep)) {
    return(data.frame(
      chisq = NA_real_,
      df = 0L,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  Vinv <- ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*%
    diag(1 / ee$values[keep], nrow = sum(keep)) %*%
    t(ee$vectors[, keep, drop = FALSE])

  W <- as.numeric(t(b) %*% Vinv %*% b)
  df <- sum(keep)
  p <- pchisq(W, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  data.frame(
    chisq = W,
    df = df,
    p_value = p
  )
}

linear_combination_hr <- function(fit, weights, label) {
  b <- coef(fit)
  V <- vcov(fit)

  missing_terms <- setdiff(names(weights), names(b))

  if (
    length(missing_terms) > 0 ||
      any(!is.finite(b[names(weights)])) ||
      any(!is.finite(V[names(weights), names(weights), drop = FALSE]))
  ) {
    return(data.frame(
      label = label,
      log_HR = NA_real_,
      SE = NA_real_,
      HR = NA_real_,
      lower_95 = NA_real_,
      upper_95 = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  w <- rep(0, length(b))
  names(w) <- names(b)
  w[names(weights)] <- weights

  est <- sum(w * b)
  se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(w) %*% V %*% w))
  z <- est / se

  data.frame(
    label = label,
    log_HR = est,
    SE = se,
    HR = exp(est),
    lower_95 = exp(est - 1.96 * se),
    upper_95 = exp(est + 1.96 * se),
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(z), lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}

make_cell_qa <- function(data, variable) {
  levs <- levels(data[[variable]])

  if (is.null(levs)) {
    levs <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[variable]])))
  }

  out <- lapply(levs, function(z) {
    d <- data[
      as.character(data[[variable]]) == z,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      variable = variable,
      level = z,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

make_sex_marriage_cell_qa <- function(data) {
  sexes <- levels(data$sex)
  marriages <- levels(data$marriage_status)

  grid <- expand.grid(
    sex = sexes,
    marriage_status = marriages,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    sx <- grid$sex[i]
    ms <- grid$marriage_status[i]

    d <- data[
      as.character(data$sex) == sx &
        as.character(data$marriage_status) == ms,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      sex = sx,
      marriage_status = ms,
      records = nrow(d),
      persons = length(unique(d$individual_id)),
      events = sum(d$event, na.rm = TRUE),
      person_years = sum(d$stop - d$start, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

print_table_section <- function(title, x, digits = 4) {
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(title, "\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")

  if (is.null(x)) {
    cat("No result available.\n")
  } else {
    print(x, row.names = FALSE, digits = digits)
  }
}

add_sheet <- function(wb, name, x) {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, x)
}

# Checks that one person's start-stop intervals do not overlap.
check_nonoverlap <- function(data) {
  ids <- unique(data$individual_id)
  bad <- character(0)

  for (id in ids) {
    d <- data[data$individual_id == id, , drop = FALSE]
    d <- d[order(d$start, d$stop), , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(d) > 1) {
      overlap <- d$start[-1] < d$stop[-nrow(d)]
      if (any(overlap, na.rm = TRUE)) {
        bad <- c(bad, id)
      }
    }
  }

  unique(bad)
}

# ---------------------------
# 2. Read and validate the common Method A object
# ---------------------------
common <- readRDS(COMMON_RDS)

required_common_objects <- c(
  "analysis_intervals",
  "income_cutoffs",
  "sample_flow",
  "group_summary",
  "hukou_qa"
)

missing_common_objects <- setdiff(
  required_common_objects,
  names(common)
)

if (length(missing_common_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The common RDS is missing required object(s): ",
    paste(missing_common_objects, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

analysis_intervals <- common$analysis_intervals

required_columns <- c(
  "individual_id",
  "household_id",
  "dibao_group",
  "start",
  "stop",
  "event",
  "person_years",
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "long_mean_household_income_pc",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",
  "hukou",
  "hukou_fixed",
  "hukou_first_wave",
  "hukou_conflict",
  "age_group"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  names(analysis_intervals)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "analysis_intervals is missing required column(s): ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Validate the shared HUKOU recoding and avoid silently using an old common RDS.
# These checks do not alter the data.
raw_hukou <- analysis_intervals$hukou_fixed
if (any(!is.na(raw_hukou) & !(raw_hukou %in% c(1, 2)))) {
  stop("Unexpected HUKOU raw value in common RDS (expected 1 or 2).")
}
expected_hukou <- ifelse(
  is.na(raw_hukou), NA_character_,
  ifelse(raw_hukou == 1, "Agricultural", "Non-agricultural")
)
if (!identical(as.character(analysis_intervals$hukou), expected_hukou)) {
  stop("HUKOU recoding in common RDS is inconsistent with 1/2 coding.")
}
if (any(!is.na(analysis_intervals$hukou_first_wave) &
        !(analysis_intervals$hukou_first_wave %in%
            c(2011, 2013, 2015, 2018, 2020)))) {
  stop("Unexpected HUKOU first-valid wave in common RDS.")
}
if (any(is.na(raw_hukou) != is.na(analysis_intervals$hukou_first_wave))) {
  stop("HUKOU first-valid wave and HUKOU missingness are inconsistent.")
}

if (length(common$income_cutoffs) != 2 ||
    any(!is.finite(common$income_cutoffs))) {
  stop("The common RDS does not contain two valid finite income cutoffs.")
}

q1 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[1])
q2 <- as.numeric(common$income_cutoffs[2])

if (!(q1 < q2)) {
  stop("Income cutoffs are invalid: q1 must be smaller than q2.")
}

# ---------------------------
# 3. Select Never Dibao records
# ---------------------------
never_data_all <- analysis_intervals[
  as.character(analysis_intervals$dibao_group) == "Never",
  , drop = FALSE
]

if (nrow(never_data_all) == 0) {
  stop("No Never Dibao person-period records were found in the common RDS.")
}

# Basic integrity checks before modeling.
if (any(is.na(never_data_all$start)) ||
    any(is.na(never_data_all$stop))) {
  stop("Never data contain missing start or stop times.")
}

if (any(never_data_all$stop <= never_data_all$start)) {
  stop("Never data contain stop <= start intervals.")
}

if (any(!never_data_all$event %in% c(0, 1))) {
  stop("Never data contain event values other than 0/1.")
}

events_per_person <- tapply(
  never_data_all$event,
  never_data_all$individual_id,
  sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (any(events_per_person > 1)) {
  stop("At least one Never participant has more than one death event.")
}

bad_overlap <- check_nonoverlap(never_data_all)
if (length(bad_overlap) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Overlapping person-period intervals detected for ",
    length(bad_overlap),
    " Never participant(s). First IDs: ",
    paste(head(bad_overlap, 10), collapse = ", ")
  )
}
# 4. Marriage Unknown handling for the formal Never Cox model
# ---------------------------
# In the current common sample, marriage Unknown is a very sparse category
# and has no death events in Never. It is retained in the common object and QA,
# but excluded from the Cox model intervals rather than estimating an unstable
# zero-event coefficient.
marriage_unknown_excluded <- never_data_all[
  as.character(never_data_all$marriage_status) == "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

# Match Ever: first exclude marriage Unknown from the Cox sample,
# then exclude intervals with HUKOU missing across ALL available waves.
# Keep these rows in the common RDS and in the exclusion QA tables.
never_after_marriage <- never_data_all[
  as.character(never_data_all$marriage_status) != "Unknown",
  , drop = FALSE
]

hukou_missing_excluded <- never_after_marriage[
  is.na(never_after_marriage$hukou), , drop = FALSE
]
never_data <- never_after_marriage[
  !is.na(never_after_marriage$hukou), , drop = FALSE
]
never_data <- droplevels(never_data)

# Re-assert reference categories and factor order.
never_data$sex <- factor(
  never_data$sex,
  levels = c("Male", "Female")
)

never_data$income_tertile <- factor(
  never_data$income_tertile,
  levels = c("T1", "T2", "T3")
)

never_data$marriage_status <- factor(
  never_data$marriage_status,
  levels = c(
    "Partnered",
    "Widowed",
    "Separated-Divorced",
    "Never married"
  )
)

never_data$living_children <- factor(
  never_data$living_children,
  levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3+", "Unknown")
)

never_data$coresident_child <- factor(
  never_data$coresident_child,
  levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown")
)

# Non-agricultural Hukou is the shared reference group in Ever and Never.
never_data$hukou <- factor(
  never_data$hukou,
  levels = c("Non-agricultural", "Agricultural")
)

never_data$age_group <- factor(
  never_data$age_group,
  levels = c("45-54", "55-64", "65-74", "75-84", "85-94", "95+")
)

if (any(is.na(never_data$sex))) {
  stop("Missing sex found in final Never Cox model data.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$income_tertile))) {
  stop("Missing income tertile found in final Never Cox model data.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$marriage_status))) {
  stop("Unexpected marriage-status code found after Never recoding/filtering.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$age_group))) {
  stop("Missing age group found in final Never Cox model data.")
}

if (any(is.na(never_data$hukou))) {
  stop("Missing HUKOU found after exclusion from Never Cox model data.")
}
if (nrow(never_data) == 0 ||
    length(unique(as.character(never_data$hukou))) < 2L) {
  stop("Never Cox model requires observations in both HUKOU categories.")
}

if (sum(never_data$event, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
  stop("No death events remain in the Never Cox model data.")
}

marriage_unknown_exclusion_summary <- data.frame(
  rule = "Marriage status Unknown excluded from Cox model intervals",
  records_excluded = nrow(marriage_unknown_excluded),
  persons_affected = length(unique(marriage_unknown_excluded$individual_id)),
  events_excluded = sum(marriage_unknown_excluded$event, na.rm = TRUE),
  person_years_excluded = sum(
    marriage_unknown_excluded$stop - marriage_unknown_excluded$start,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Same HUKOU-missing exclusion definition and summary as Ever.
hukou_missing_exclusion_summary <- data.frame(
  rule = "First non-missing HUKOU absent in all waves: excluded from Cox",
  records_excluded = nrow(hukou_missing_excluded),
  persons_affected = length(unique(hukou_missing_excluded$individual_id)),
  events_excluded = sum(hukou_missing_excluded$event, na.rm = TRUE),
  person_years_excluded = sum(
    hukou_missing_excluded$stop - hukou_missing_excluded$start,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# HUKOU QA was calculated from person histories by the updated Ever script.
# Reuse exactly that shared QA; do not recalculate from the Cox subset.
hukou_qa <- common$hukou_qa

# ---------------------------
# 5. Sample summaries and common income cutoffs
# ---------------------------
sample_summary <- data.frame(
  stage = c(
    "Never in common Method A data",
    "Never after excluding marriage Unknown",

  ),

  ),

  ),

    nrow(never_data)
  ),
  person_years = c(
    sum(never_data_all$stop - never_data_all$start, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(never_after_marriage$stop - never_after_marriage$start, na.rm = TRUE),

  ),

    sum(never_data$event, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),

)

income_cutoff_table <- data.frame(

  value = c(q1, q2),

# ---------------------------
# 6. Never Dibao main Cox model
# ---------------------------
main_formula <- Surv(start, stop, event) ~
  sex +
  income_tertile +
  marriage_status +
  living_children +
  coresident_child +
  hukou +
  strata(age_group)

main_fit_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(
  main_formula,
  never_data
)

main_fit <- main_fit_obj$fit
main_results <- extract_cox_results(main_fit)
main_results_readable <- make_readable_main_results(main_results)
# 7. PH diagnostic
# ---------------------------
main_ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
  main_formula,
  never_data,
  main_fit
)

main_ph <- main_ph_diag$object
main_ph_table <- main_ph_diag$table

ph_diagnostic_info <- data.frame(
  model = "Never main Cox",
  diagnostic_source = main_ph_diag$source,
  primary_error = ifelse(
    is.na(main_ph_diag$primary_error),
    "",
    main_ph_diag$primary_error
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ---------------------------
# 8. Auxiliary Sex x Marital status analysis
# ---------------------------
# The main Cox model keeps all observed substantive marital categories.
# The auxiliary interaction model is stricter because sex-specific sparse cells
# can create infinite interaction coefficients.
sex_marriage_cell_qa <- make_sex_marriage_cell_qa(never_data)

marital_nonref <- setdiff(
  levels(never_data$marriage_status),
  "Partnered"
)

supported_marital_levels <- character(0)

for (lev in marital_nonref) {
  z <- sex_marriage_cell_qa[
    sex_marriage_cell_qa$marriage_status == lev &
      sex_marriage_cell_qa$sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (
    nrow(z) == 2 &&
      all(z$events >= MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL)
  ) {
    supported_marital_levels <- c(
      supported_marital_levels,
      lev
    )
  }
}

sex_marriage_level_eligibility <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(marital_nonref, function(lev) {
    z <- sex_marriage_cell_qa[
      sex_marriage_cell_qa$marriage_status == lev &
        sex_marriage_cell_qa$sex %in% c("Male", "Female"),
      , drop = FALSE
    ]

    data.frame(
      marriage_status = lev,
      male_events = if (any(z$sex == "Male")) {
        z$events[z$sex == "Male"][1]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      female_events = if (any(z$sex == "Female")) {
        z$events[z$sex == "Female"][1]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      eligible_for_sex_interaction =
        lev %in% supported_marital_levels,
      rule = paste0(
        ">=",
        MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL,
        " deaths in each sex-specific cell"
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

sex_marriage_fit <- NULL
sex_marriage_coefficients <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_block <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_level_HRs <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_ph <- NULL
sex_marriage_ph_table <- data.frame()
sex_marriage_warnings <- character(0)

if (length(supported_marital_levels) > 0) {
  sex_marriage_data <- never_data[
    as.character(never_data$marriage_status) %in%
      c("Partnered", supported_marital_levels),
    , drop = FALSE
  ]

  sex_marriage_data <- droplevels(sex_marriage_data)

  sex_marriage_data$sex <- factor(
    sex_marriage_data$sex,
    levels = c("Male", "Female")
  )

  sex_marriage_data$marriage_status <- factor(
    sex_marriage_data$marriage_status,
    levels = c("Partnered", supported_marital_levels)
  )

  sex_marriage_formula <- Surv(start, stop, event) ~
    sex * marriage_status +
    income_tertile +
    living_children +
    coresident_child +
    hukou +
    strata(age_group)

  sex_marriage_obj <- fit_cox_with_warnings(
    sex_marriage_formula,
    sex_marriage_data
  )

  sex_marriage_fit <- sex_marriage_obj$fit
  sex_marriage_warnings <- sex_marriage_obj$warnings
  sex_marriage_coefficients <- extract_cox_results(
    sex_marriage_fit
  )

  interaction_terms <- grep(
    ":",
    names(coef(sex_marriage_fit)),
    value = TRUE
  )

  sex_marriage_block <- wald_block(
    sex_marriage_fit,
    interaction_terms
  )

  sex_marriage_block$test <-
    "Sex x Marital status overall interaction (eligible levels only)"

  sex_marriage_block <- sex_marriage_block[
    , c("test", "chisq", "df", "p_value")
  ]

  # Sex-specific marital-status HRs relative to Partnered.
  for (lev in supported_marital_levels) {
    main_term <- paste0(
      "marriage_status",
      lev
    )

    male_row <- linear_combination_hr(
      sex_marriage_fit,
      setNames(1, main_term),
      paste0(
        "Male: ",
        lev,
        " vs Partnered"
      )
    )

    possible_interactions <- c(
      paste0(
        "sexFemale:marriage_status",
        lev
      ),
      paste0(
        "marriage_status",
        lev,
        ":sexFemale"
      )
    )

    int_term <- possible_interactions[
      possible_interactions %in%
        names(coef(sex_marriage_fit))
    ]

    if (length(int_term) == 1) {
      female_row <- linear_combination_hr(
        sex_marriage_fit,
        setNames(
          c(1, 1),
          c(main_term, int_term)
        ),
        paste0(
          "Female: ",
          lev,
          " vs Partnered"
        )
      )
    } else {
      female_row <- data.frame(
        label = paste0(
          "Female: ",
          lev,
          " vs Partnered"
        ),
        log_HR = NA_real_,
        SE = NA_real_,
        HR = NA_real_,
        lower_95 = NA_real_,
        upper_95 = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_
      )
    }

    sex_marriage_level_HRs <- rbind(
      sex_marriage_level_HRs,
      male_row,
      female_row
    )
  }

  sex_marriage_ph_diag <- run_ph_diagnostic(
    sex_marriage_formula,
    sex_marriage_data,
    sex_marriage_fit
  )

  sex_marriage_ph <- sex_marriage_ph_diag$object
  sex_marriage_ph_table <- sex_marriage_ph_diag$table

} else {
  sex_marriage_block <- data.frame(
    test = "Sex x Marital status overall interaction",
    chisq = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p_value = NA_real_,
    note = paste0(
      "Not fitted: no non-reference marital level met the >=",
      MIN_EVENTS_PER_SEX_MARRIAGE_CELL,
      " deaths-per-sex rule."
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  sex_marriage_ph_table <- data.frame(
    term = "NOT_FITTED",
    chisq = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    p = NA_real_,
    message = "Sex x Marital status model not fitted because of sparse cells.",
    diagnostic_source = NA_character_,
    primary_error = NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

qa_variables <- c(
  "sex",
  "income_tertile",
  "marriage_status",
  "living_children",
  "coresident_child",

)

cell_qa <- do.call(

}

# ---------------------------
# 15. Directly display results in R / RStudio
# ---------------------------
never_model_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = c(
    "Persons in Never main model",
    "Households in Never main model",
    "Person-intervals in Never main model",
    "Person-years in Never main model",
    "Death events in Never main model",
    "Income T1/T2 cutoff",
    "Income T2/T3 cutoff",
    "Marriage Unknown intervals excluded",
    "HUKOU-missing intervals excluded",
    "HUKOU-missing persons affected",
    "HUKOU-missing death events excluded"
  ),
  value = c(
    length(unique(never_data$individual_id)),
    length(unique(never_data$household_id)),
    nrow(never_data),
    round(sum(never_data$stop - never_data$start, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sum(never_data$event, na.rm = TRUE),
    round(q1, 4),
    round(q2, 4),
    nrow(marriage_unknown_excluded),
    nrow(hukou_missing_excluded),
    length(unique(hukou_missing_excluded$individual_id)),
    sum(hukou_missing_excluded$event, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print_table_section(
  "METHOD A - NEVER DIBAO: ANALYSIS SAMPLE",
  never_model_summary
)

print_table_section(
  "MAIN COX RESULTS: HR, 95% CI, AND P VALUE",
  main_results_readable[
    , c("comparison", "HR_95CI", "p_display"),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

cat("\nFull coxph model summary:\n")
print(summary(main_fit))

print_table_section(
  "PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS (PH) DIAGNOSTIC",
  main_ph_table
)

print_table_section(
  "PH DIAGNOSTIC SOURCE",
  ph_diagnostic_info
)

print_table_section(
  "MARRIAGE UNKNOWN EXCLUSION QA",
  marriage_unknown_exclusion_summary
)

print_table_section(
  "HUKOU MISSING EXCLUSION QA",
  hukou_missing_exclusion_summary
)

print_table_section(
  "HUKOU PERSON-WAVE QA (SHARED COMMON DATA)",
  hukou_qa
)

print_table_section(
  "SEX x MARITAL STATUS CELL COUNTS",
  sex_marriage_cell_qa
)

print_table_section(
  "SEX x MARITAL STATUS LEVEL ELIGIBILITY",
  sex_marriage_level_eligibility
)

print_table_section(
  "SEX x MARITAL STATUS OVERALL INTERACTION",
  sex_marriage_block
)

if (nrow(sex_marriage_level_HRs) > 0) {
  print_table_section(
    "SEX-SPECIFIC MARITAL-STATUS HRs",
    sex_marriage_level_HRs
  )
}

print_table_section(
  "SPARSE-CELL QA (<5 EVENTS)",
  sparse_qa
)

print_table_section(
  "MODEL WARNINGS",
  model_warning_table
)

# In RStudio / interactive R, automatically open the most useful tables.
if (interactive()) {
  View(
    main_results_readable,
    title = "Never Dibao - Main Cox Results"
  )

  View(
    main_ph_table,
    title = "Never Dibao - PH Diagnostic"
  )

  View(
    sex_marriage_level_eligibility,
    title = "Never Dibao - Sex x Marriage Eligibility"
  )
}

cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Method A - Never Dibao Cox analysis completed successfully.\n")
cat(
  "Common RDS used: ",
  COMMON_RDS,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(

  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "A_Never_Dibao_Cox_results.xlsx"),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "PH diagnostic source: ",
  main_ph_diag$source,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "Marriage Unknown intervals excluded from main Cox model: ",
  nrow(marriage_unknown_excluded),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(
  "HUKOU-missing intervals excluded from main Cox model: ",
  nrow(hukou_missing_excluded),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
cat(paste(rep("=", 72), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
```
